audit.whatIsWrong: The entry says seven separate times that Pantheon's PASSIVE blocks autos and turret shots from the front, and builds the level-6 plan on getting behind it. His passive does nothing of the kind.
audit.why: Riot's text for Mortal Will: 'Every few spells or attacks, Pantheon's next spell is empowered.' That is a counter that upgrades his next cast — no blocking, no directionality. The frontal invulnerability belongs to Aegis Assault (E): 'Pantheon sets his shield, becoming invulnerable to damage from the front and striking repeatedly with his spear.' So the property is real but it is an ability on a 22/21/20/19/18 cooldown that he has to commit, not a permanent passive he wears. Those are completely different problems: one you time, the other you position around forever.
audit.corrected: Every reference reassigned — Aegis Assault named with its 22s at rank 1 in spikes[0].text, spikes[1].text, early, mid, wants.you[1], wants.foe[1], whys[2] and whys[4]; Mortal Will described for what it is in whys[0].
sources: champ-data/_kits/pantheon.json (P Mortal Will, E Aegis Assault)

audit.whatIsWrong: The recorded defect is that no Pantheon ability is named anywhere in the matchup, and no cooldown appears either — every instruction is 'his W', 'his Q spear', 'his passive'.
audit.why: The real kit is Mortal Will (P), Comet Spear (Q, 11/10.25/9.5/8.75/8 at 575), Shield Vault (W, 13/12/11/10/9 at 600), Aegis Assault (E, 22/21/20/19/18 at 400) and Grand Starfall (R, 180/165/150 at 5500). Two of those numbers change decisions: Aegis Assault at 22s is the longest basic ability in the lane and the window after it is the whole all-in, and Grand Starfall at 180s means a Pantheon who roams has nothing left for two and a half minutes.
audit.corrected: All five named, with cooldowns in spikes[0].text, spikes[1].text, early, mid, whys[1], whys[3], breakdown.cooldowns and dosFull[0].d.

audit.whatIsWrong: Shield Vault is called a 'point-and-click stun he can land the instant you step up'. It is a dash.
audit.why: Riot's text: 'Pantheon dashes to a target, damaging and stunning them.' 600 range, 13s at rank 1, and the kit derives an auto reset from it. The distinction matters for spacing: it is not a stun he lands where he stands, it is 600 units of closing speed attached to a stun, which is why 'don't walk into W-range' understates how far W-range reaches.
audit.corrected: early, whys[1] and wants.foe[0] now say a 600-range dash-stun with an auto reset.

audit.whatIsWrong: 'The flat-armor-pen R' and 'the armor pen plus heal-on-ability-damage means your E slow into empowered autos sticks and you stay healthy' — in spikes[1].text, mid and whys[4].
audit.why: Riot's Public Execution text: 'blinks to the farthest enemy champion in a line of her choosing and suppresses them upon her arrival. She then slams the enemy into the ground where they take damage and are stunned.' No penetration, no healing, no passive. The true reason it beats him is better anyway: Aegis Assault is a channel, and a suppressed Pantheon cannot keep channelling it.
audit.corrected: Replaced in all three with the suppression and the Aegis Assault channel interaction.

audit.whatIsWrong: 'Farm with the outer edge of Cunning Sweep' and 'last-hit at Cunning Sweep's outer edge' present an edge sweetspot she does not have.
audit.why: Riot's text: she 'sweeps her twin drakehounds in a semicircle in front of her, dealing bonus damage to enemies hit by the blades'. The bonus is for the blades, and the ability is 650 range. Against a 575-range Comet Spear and a 600-range Shield Vault, knowing the real number is what makes 'farm at max range' actionable.
audit.corrected: early, wants.you[0] and whys[0] now use the blades and the 650.

audit.whatIsWrong: Grand Starfall is mentioned once as 'a global R roam' with no cost attached.
audit.why: It is 180 seconds at rank 1 from 5500 range. A Pantheon who spends it on another lane has no ultimate for three minutes, which is the single largest window Ambessa gets before her item spike. That is a jungle-and-map fact the entry never converts into an instruction.

edits.before: Pantheon owns these levels and you have to respect it. His W is a point-and-click stun he can land the instant you step up to last-hit, and his Q spear pokes you for free while his passive blocks autos and turret shots from the front — including your empowered basic. You have one ability and energy gating at Level 1 plus long cooldowns at 2-3, so don't try to force a dash-weave trade you'll lose. Farm with the outer edge of Cunning Sweep at max range, eat the poke, and never walk into W-range to throw a Q he can simply stun you out of.
edits.after: Pantheon owns these levels and you have to respect it. Shield Vault is a 600-range dash onto you with a stun and an auto reset attached, and Comet Spear pokes for free from 575 on 11s. Aegis Assault then makes him invulnerable to damage from the FRONT — not a passive, a 22s ability he has to commit — so the answer is to be behind him or to be elsewhere. With one ability, an energy gate at 1 and long cooldowns at 2-3, don't force a dash-weave you'll lose. Farm with the blades of Cunning Sweep at 650 and eat the poke.

edits.before: Levels 4-5 are still his — his cooldowns are short and yours are at their longest, so keep farming toward your spike instead of trading into the stun. Level 6 is the flip: Public Execution blinks you behind him, so his frontal passive can't block the crash, the suppress locks out his W escape, and the flat armor pen plus heal-on-ability-damage means your E slow into empowered autos sticks and you stay healthy through it. Bait his W before you ult if you can — once that stun is down your all-in is clean and he has no second way out.
edits.after: Levels 4-5 are still his — his cooldowns are short and yours are at their longest, so keep farming toward your spike instead of trading into the stun. Level 6 is the flip: Public Execution blinks 1250 to the farthest champion in the line and suppresses on arrival, and a suppressed Pantheon cannot keep channelling Aegis Assault or vault away. Bait Shield Vault first if you can — with the stun down and his 22s E either spent or cut short, the all-in is clean and he has no second way out.

notes: The headline error is an outdated passive. Seven strings in this matchup say Pantheon's PASSIVE blocks autos and turret shots from the front, and the level-6 plan is built on blinking behind it. Riot's current Mortal Will just empowers his next spell after a few casts or attacks. The frontal invulnerability is Aegis Assault (E) — a 22-second ability he has to commit and a channel, not a permanent property of standing in front of him — which changes it from a positioning rule into a cooldown you can wait out or interrupt. Public Execution's invented 'flat armour pen and heal on ability damage' was removed here too; the suppression ending an Aegis Assault channel is both true and a better reason. Cunning Sweep's 'outer edge' sweetspot does not exist either — the bonus is for the blades, and her 650 range against his 575 and 600 is the number that makes the farming instruction usable. LEVEL CHART: the chart gives Pantheon four stages and Ambessa none, which fits her 48.54% over 377 games, but the prose on First item and Two-plus items reads as hers ('By first item this is yours', 'Pantheon is irrelevant late'). I steered those two rewrites onto the half that supports the chart — his fall-off is real, but her all-physical damage stalling into armour is why the stage is not hers — rather than proposing a side flip the length band would reject.
